messages:
Ilana: Quick question for the group ‹: how do we route traffic across hosted/dedicated/private without transmitting tenant secrets?
Ilana: Scenario: on-prem control plane wants to receive traffic for a tenant but fall back to hosted on failure. We must avoid secret leakage across trust boundaries.
Matt: Two patterns: (A) ephemeral-forwarding: mint short-lived creds and forward them, or (B) reference-and-fetch: send a signed policy token; runtime fetches secrets from its own KMS.
Toma: Strong +1 for reference-and-fetch. Never copy secrets. The runtime should fetch based on a proof token that asserts routing policy.
Ben: Agreed. We should add manifest fields: secret_ref entries + per-tenant failover policy. Example snippet: 
```
secrets:
  - name: MODEL_KEY
    ref: secret://tenant/keys/model
    strategy: reference
routing:
  privileged_routing: true
  on_unreachable: fail|fallback_hosted|queue
```
Ilana: Important: regulated tenants default to fail. Legal needs to sign off on fallback_hosted.
Matt: Implementation idea: control plane issues a short JWT (proof token) with claims {tenant, allowed_failovers, secret_strategy} signed by CP. Edge attaches token; runtime verifies and uses its own identity to fetch secrets. Edge never carries raw creds.
Toma: That solves auditability: token includes nonce and request_id. Runtime emits an audit event when it fetches a secret. But we must handle verifier key rotation, TTLs, and clock skew.
Ben: Ops checklist: add JWKS endpoint for verifiers, define rotation window, TTL short (seconds), allow small clock skew, and add trace fields: routing_decision, secret_strategy, proof_token_id, outcome, fetch_actor.
Ilana: Network partitions: for high-compliance tenants, on_unreachable=fail. For others, tenant can opt into fallback_hosted or queue. Streaming calls complicate queued fallback; prefer fast failure unless tenant explicitly allows async queuing.
Matt: Also, runtime registration should surface its KMS accessibility and allowed fallback modes so edge can make routing decisions without guessing.
Ben: Action items:
- Toma: PR for manifest schema (secret_ref + on_unreachable).
- Matt: PoC proof-token issuer + verifier libs and rotation doc.
- Ben: Add observability fields and audit event definitions.
- Ilana: Sync legal on default failover policy for regulated tenants.
ops-bot: Deploybot: created ticket INF-5234 for prototype work (https://tracker/redwood/INF-5234)
Ilana: If prototype looks good we'll escalate to an RFC. Keep this thread light. :thumbsup:
